snippet.title: A WICKED GAME - Official Gameplay Trailer | Demo available now!
snippet.description:
In A Wicked Game, the rules are unclear or incomplete. There may or may not be feedback. Patterns will be hard to find. A Wicked Game demands the player know things which are never taught, demands that they contort themselves to a constantly-changing control scheme, and success requires mastery combined with luck. The characters you meet are deliberately inhospitable. They are impatient, rude, and inconsistent. They will help you and harm you, but it will be unclear which is happening. Trust is hard to find here.

Play the DEMO and Wishlist today! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3242940/a_wicked_game/

What players are saying:
"Warioware meets Jump King, a play-through of a wicked game leaves you frustrated yet tantalized, begrudgingly trying to find the button to try again."

"I was extremely surprised by this game. I gave it a shot and ended up playing it for 3 hours. It's simple, yet fun, challenging but not unbearably difficult. Honestly, I don't even normally post reviews but I had to on this one."

"This game definitely gives the "World's Hardest Game" vibe in 2025."

Can you beat this deceptively simple rage game? My guess is probably not :)
